java.say: Bird only promises what every bird can do: eat.
FlyingBird adds fly(). Only birds that can fly extend it.
A parrot can fly, so it is a FlyingBird.
A penguin is just a Bird. It never promised to fly; it swims.
This loop only takes flying birds.
So every call to fly() works. No subclass breaks a promise.
